details.report: Committed a forward repair at b01f686. Navigator validation now compares the submitted read record to the evidence store's authoritative byte-coverage record; arbitrary Recorder transport throws retain their original rejection identity and no longer become fabricated settlements; lifecycle publication conflicts reread and reconcile canonical winners while preserving atomic no-replace; latestAttempt is deeply closed and UUIDv7 validation is shared; promoted argv is scanned by the Recorder credential scanner before any durable run activity. Verification passed: focused Navigator/Assisted production-seam tests, npm run typecheck, hermetic full npm test (366 passed, 5 skipped), npm pack --dry-run, and git diff --check. Existing tests were retained and strengthened; no findings were relabeled or assertion paths weakened.
